items.desc: @gigigigigigigi Texan-born producer and DJ Gi Gi joined me for episode 381 of Passing Notes. Gi Gi shapes worlds of organic ambient and downtempo, lit by glimpses of spellbinding shoegaze and underpinned by dub-inspired heavyweight basslines. He has a rare gift for sampling, assembling found sounds into complete wholes so natural you'd swear they came into existence that way. His cinematic 2021 LP Lumino Pleco was built entirely from samples from icons of the likes Prince, Erykah Badu, Vangelis and Miles Davis, reshaped and recontextualised to say something completely new. An approach that in…
items.title: Gi Gi - PN 381

items.desc: Beaming in from the central mountains of Colombia and onto the Passing Notes airwaves for episode 343 is Lopar (@lopar_music). The NATURAL resident has spent the past 8+ years slowly and steadily carving out a place in Colombia’s underground, sharing line‑ups with a wide spread of international heads across clubs, DIY spaces and independent platforms. He’s also appeared at the Colombian edition of Extra Mostra, an audiovisual and experimental outpost dedicated to immersive electronics and contemporary artistic expression. Lopar’s sets are carefully plotted, instinctive emotional arcs that qui…
items.title: Lopar - PN 373

items.desc: Art is a Trawlwoolway Pakana man from Lutruwita/Tasmania and co-founder of the event series and music platform Nuyina. Specialising in a highly refined palette of minimal, deep house, dub techno and ambient, Art's DJ philosophy is underpinned by patient pacing and subtle, steady builds. His collection brims with the beauty of minimalism, records that demand precise mixing to yield maximum impact. Art’s intentional approach to selection and story builds immersive experiences that reward close listening – whether in the deep listening room or on the dancefloor, Art's sets invite listeners to st…
items.title: Art - PN 372

items.desc: adobeprincess is an NYC-based DJ crafting patient, emotionally driven sets defined by her refined ear and understated confidence behind the decks. Channeling a polished yet playful energy, adobeprincess’ expertise lies in guiding listeners through evolving states of well-timed euphoria, dancefloor daydreaming, and intimate introspection - intuitively balancing tension and release with a sultry sensibility and a playful, dreamlike edge. Underpinned by her artful selections of sultry tech house, low-slung dubby minimal, and weightless breaks, adobeprincess leans into the spirit of 90s and 00s p…
items.title: adobeprincess - PN 368

items.desc: They say never meet your heroes, but that advice doesn’t quite hold up when one of your heroes is Dr Nicole Skeltys. @nicoleskeltys A pioneering artist, musician, composer and producer, Nicole’s career spans more than three decades and twelve albums, moving through quirky dance, lo fi electronica and psychedelic folk across a multitude of formats. She is best known as one half of the seminal electro-femme duo B(if)tek alongside Kate Crawford, whose influence on Australian electronic music remains profound. Alongside this, her solo project Artificial and extensive work across film, television,…
items.title: In conversation with...Nicole Skeltys (Artificial/B(if)tek) - PN 366

items.desc: ANNX is a DJ, curator, and shining light in the world of electronic music. Known for her authentic and highly engaged presence both on and off the dancefloor, her constant exploration and immersion in vibrant cities and diverse dancefloors have shaped her unique, seductive style, spanning trance, prog, psy, techno, tech house, and dubstep. As a DJ, ANNX has solidified her reputation as a dynamic and versatile artist and a staple on the UK and European club and festival circuit. Notable appearances include sets at UNFOLD, SUB:SYSTEM, Hors-Sol Paris, Macadam, Shambala, and more. Beyond her capt…
items.title: ANNX - PN 361

items.desc: From the suburban fringes of Frankston to far and wide, it’s hard to understate the lasting legacy of childhood friends Corey Kikos and Maryos Syawish, Sleep D on the contemporary music landscape. Having reached near-mythic status, the trusted pundits’ indelible impact is inseparable from Butter Sessions, the blog-turned-label they founded online in 2011 and later with the release of Sleep D’s iconic The Jackal EP. What began as an online platform quickly evolved into a bedrock institution within Melbourne’s house and techno scene. Now 15 years on and 40+ releases deep, Butter Sessions stands…
items.title: Sleep D - PN 360

items.desc: The boundless creativity of antipodean artists has shaped the global electronic music landscape in special ways over recent years. Shining bright amongst the many artists swimming in the local talent pool is Havsat Informant (Mike Blyth), recognised for his meticulously crafted take on hypnotic techno and its softer derivatives. Blyth’s sound is hyper-detailed, cinematic, and all-encompassing - sculpted with surgical precision that reveals new dimensions with each layer cut away and every listen. His signature style whilst energetically diverse comes together and converges in the minutiae, wh…
items.title: Hasvat Informant - PN 359

items.desc: Avsluta is the project of Czech-born, London-based sound alchemist Lucie Štěpánková - a composer, DJ, curator, and live performer whose work invites deep, intentional listening in an age of constant acceleration. Inspired by the life and teachings of Pauline Oliveros, as well as her years of study in sound art, Avsluta’s practice is rooted in listening and presence as a practice. To me, Avsluta has always been a reminder of the slow life - encouraging slowness and reflection while drawing attention to how our living environments are shaped by sound. Her ritualistic music-making practice often…
items.title: Avsluta - PN 353

items.desc: For more than two decades, Simon Huxtable has been actively creating, composing, and releasing music under a constellation of monikers, including Inhmost, Aural Imbalance, and collaborative projects such as Deep Space Organisms. His output, though exceptionally consistent, has always been guided less by industry expectation and more by the therapeutic effects of music making and an innate need to create. Longevity, for him, isn’t a strategy but a natural consequence of devotion and the essential presence of music in his life. For me, the most striking component of Simon’s work has always been…
items.title: Inhmost - PN 352

items.desc: @bambi-dj Guided by a deep sense of care, intention-setting, and curiosity, Bambi comes to the end of 2025 closing a career-defining chapter of her practice. From the misty Norwegian forest floor of Monument to the charged dancefloors of Nowadays, the Paris-based resident and touring DJ, producer, and curator’s year has been shaped by appearances across Europe, the US, and soon, down under. Attuned to the rhythm of life on the road, Bambi approaches every set as an act of dialogue between the places she visits, the community and culture she engages with, and her own colourful emotional world.…
items.title: Bambi - PN 350 [Live at Outrebleu]

items.desc: @djpgz @yikesone Two of the most vital voices in so-called Australia’s dance music landscape, heavyweight producers DJ PGZ and Yikes, joined me for episode 315 of Passing Notes. Fresh off the release of their fierce new split EP ‘Come Round’ via Butter Sessions, these two stewards of contemporary dance music and club culture show us what happens when deep musical knowledges, community-first ethos, and production prowess collide. Come Round is a bold, percussive journey through techno and its playful yet unrelenting derivatives. The tracklist features solo cuts, cross-remixes and one standout …
items.title: DJ PGZ & Yikes - PN 315

items.desc: Saphileaum is the alias of Georgian producer, multi-disciplinary artist and KHIDI club resident Andro Gogibedashvili. Emerging from a profoundly creative family-actors, singers, writers, and poets, Andro’s creative path has been profoundly shaped by his heritage and the traditions that surround it. Saphileaum makes music for coming together, for meditation, and for mystical, philosophical musings. A sound crafted as unique and consistent as his, only possible through a lifelong passion and commitment to artistic expression. Often drawing on disparate genres, his unique sound is brought togeth…
items.title: Saphileaum - PN 318

items.desc: @zeynep To celebrate 6 years of Passing Notes and International Women’s Day just passed, I enlisted the help of Berlin-based Syrian DJ, curator and goddess Zeynep. Zeynep’s voice is no stranger to Passing Notes, she joined me live in the studio with the Harmony Rec crew for episode 256 back in February 2024. Today, she returns in sonic form from afar, to showcase her fervent musical voice. A dynamic selector who strikes a captivating balance between smooth lusciousness and unruly bodaciousness, Zeynep’s performances are impassioned trips through deeply dug mesmeric trance, seductive prog, and…
items.title: Zeynep - PN 313 (6 Years of PN)

items.desc: @liquidearthmusic Emerging from the sun-drenched landscapes of California and now firmly rooted in the Barcelona sands, Liquid Earth has spent years sculpting a signature sound that’s equal parts classic and contemporary. Wrangling sounds inspired by the ‘80s-‘00s continuum of effervescent house and reimagining them with a hardware and futuristic-forward twist, Freels’ sophisticated brand of ‘tech house’ has resulted in years of quality output to boot. With a career further propelled by his unmatched positive attitude and razor sharp dancefloor instincts, Freels has released under several mon…
items.title: Liquid Earth - PN 307

items.desc: Utrecht based producer, live artist and ISOTOOP label head, @vandmusic, joined me for episode 305 of Passing Notes. Collaboration is a central feature of Vand’s story so far - his fast growing list of celebrated collaborative projects include VOAL (Vand + Shoal) as well as releases alongside Passing Notes alumni Alfred Czital and of course Bas Dobbelaer. Across these projects you’ll find disparate sounds brought together by meeting of the minds and production prowess. His release with Alfred Czital ‘P.J.M’ on Harmoney Rec unsurprisingly showcases a colourful club-ready side, with sounds punct…
items.title: Vand - PN 305

items.desc: @melquiadesmusic Good friend and constant source of inspiration Alex Albrecht, joined me to celebrate my 300th episode of Passing Notes. Few artists channel a consistent stream of creativity like Alex Albrecht. With over a decade of music-making under his belt, Alex has cultivated a distinct and frankly iconic musical identity. Effortlessly shapeshifting between experimental jazz, ambient, atmospheric house, and deep techno, Alex’s compositions are marked by an environmental undertone that imbues them with a uniquely “Alex Albrecht” earthly sense of place. items.title: Alex Albrecht [LIVE] - PN 300

items.desc: @rambadu Rambadu’s inspiration lies in his fascination with the energetic and healing properties of sound. Years of introspection and meticulous research have shaped his ability to channel the unseen forces of our inner and outer worlds into textured, immersive and deeply hypnotic compositions. His music uses elements such as singing bowls, acoustic instruments, hardware based synthesis, which are also enriched by modulated field recordings. Rambadu’s psychedelic take on deep techno highlights his dedication to exploring the symbiosis of art, nature, and the human spirit. His recent collabora…
items.title: Rambadu - PN 301

items.desc: @vardaemusic Vardae’s creative world is deeply rooted in the psychedelic experience. Dreamed up by an auditory alchemist, Vardae’s highly imaginative take on techno combines microscopic detail, intricate rhythms, celestial soundscapes, and a pervasive depth that pushes listeners to the edges of their perception. Vardae’s sound is visceral, exuding a ritualistic quality and an alluring, primal energy that bridges the gap between music for the body, mind, and the spirit. items.title: Vardae - PN 302

items.desc: @sleepexchange Stepping up to the Passing Notes plate for episode 297 is Naarm-based DJ and producer Sleep Exchange. Known for his dynamic and precise mixing style, Sleep Exchange immerses himself in the depths of sonic exploration, often lurking around the sludgy sea floor of sound. His production work combines characteristic sludge-like low ends, dripping soundscapes and intricate layers of crisp percussion that bring the murkiest of musical landscapes to life. items.desc: @simon-tk Simon TK is a multifaceted music operator. A true champion of diversity in sound and community, it’s hard to overstate the impact that Simon has had on the Melbourne music community across his over-a-decade long involvement in all areas of the scene. At the heart of this involvement is Simon’s expansive musical knowledge. An exceptionally versatile DJ, Simon is one of those rare selectors you could call upon to soundtrack almost any occasion - not just appropriately but perfectly.
